name: sky-collector-native
description: Native iOS/Android shell for Sky Collector (Capacitor), copied from Space Collector's native/ (2026-11-19). The web app at the repo root stays build-free.

scripts.ios: node copy-web.mjs && node patch-plugins.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android: node copy-web.mjs && node patch-plugins.mjs && npx cap sync android
